auth.signInLede: Get to your scripts and recordings.
auth.badCredentials: That email or password isn't right. Check both and try again.
auth.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email, like name{'@'}example.com
auth.passwordMismatch: The passwords don't match. Type it again.
auth.nameRequired: Enter your name as you'd like it to appear.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.lede: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
recovery.sentLede: If this email belongs to an account, you'll get a message with a link to reset your password.
recovery.mockHint: This preview sends no real email. Open the mock panel to find the link.

reset.title: New password
reset.expiredLede: Reset links work once, for one hour. Request a new one.
reset.invalidLede: It may have been used already or copied incompletely. Request a new one.

invite.title: Create your account
invite.lede: Your invitation is ready. Choose your name and password to start.
invite.name: Name
invite.namePlaceholder: As you'd like it to appear
invite.agree: I agree to the {terms} and the {privacy}.
invite.agreeRequired: Agree to the terms and privacy policy to continue.
invite.expiredLede: Invitations work for seven days. Join the waitlist and we'll send you a new one.
invite.invalidLede: It may already have been used to create an account. If that account is yours, sign in.

waitlist.title: Join the waitlist
waitlist.lede: We open sign-ups in batches. We'll email you when your invitation is ready.
waitlist.doneLede: We'll send your invitation to this email when sign-ups open.

errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.tokenExpired: This link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.tokenInvalid: This link doesn't work. Request a new one.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in to continue.

placeholder.title: {screen}
placeholder.text: This screen comes in the next phase of the plan.

library.emptyLede: Start from a blank page or import a text file.
library.noPinned: No pinned scripts yet. Pin one from its options menu to see it here.
library.titleTooLong: That title is too long. Keep it under 120 characters.
library.importLede: Choose a text file from your device.
library.importHint: A TXT file up to 1 MB. Blank lines become paragraph breaks.

importError.type: That isn't a TXT file. Choose a text file ending in .txt.
importError.empty: The file is empty. Choose a file that contains text.
importError.size: The file is over 1 MB. Split it into smaller files.
importError.read: Couldn't read the file. Try saving it as UTF-8.

library.downloadLede: Ready to save on your device.

editor.bodyPlaceholder: Start writing here. Leave a blank line between paragraphs.
editor.noText: Write to see the reading time
editor.restored: We recovered unsaved edits from your last visit on this device and are saving them now.
editor.missingText: It may have been deleted or moved to another account.

marks.title: Delivery marks
marks.noSelection: Select words in the script to add emphasis or a note, or place the cursor where you want a pause.

conflict.title: This script changed somewhere else
conflict.lede: Compare both copies before choosing what to keep.
conflict.saveMine: Save my edits as a new script
conflict.confirmLede: The account copy will replace your edits on this device. You can go back and save your edits as a new script.

reader.title: Rehearsal

settings.title: Reading settings
settings.saveFailed: Couldn't save reading settings to your account. They stay as they are here and we'll try again when you change them.
settings.directionFailed: Couldn't save the text direction. Try again.

recovery.title: Couldn't save your reading position
recovery.lede: You can keep reading from here.

end.title: End of script
end.lede: You reached the last paragraph. Start again or move on to recording.

reader.empty: This script is empty. Write a paragraph in the editor to rehearse it.

studio.title: Recording studio
studio.videoLede: Allow the camera and microphone to preview the picture and test the sound.
studio.audioLede: Allow the microphone to check the sound level before recording.
studio.videoReady: Check the framing and sound level before recording.
studio.audioReady: Listen to your sound level before recording.
studio.takeLimit: Takes can be up to 10 minutes
studio.deniedVideo: Couldn't access the camera and microphone
studio.deniedLede: You can go back to setup or keep rehearsing without recording.
studio.unavailable: No camera or microphone is connected to this device. Connect one and try again.
studio.unsupported: This browser can't record. Try a recent Chrome, Safari or Firefox.
studio.errorGeneric: Couldn't start the camera or microphone. Make sure no other app is using them, then try again.
studio.deviceLost: The device disconnected. Turn it on again to continue.
studio.helpStep1: Click the lock or camera icon next to the page address.
studio.helpStep2: Choose “Allow” for the camera and microphone.
studio.helpStep3: Come back and press “Try again”. You may need to reload the page.
studio.helpNote: Recordings stay in this browser and are never uploaded.
studio.savedLimit: The take reached 10 minutes, so it stopped and was saved.
studio.savedInterrupted: Recording stopped because the device disconnected or you left the page. What was captured is saved.
studio.savedQuota: Browser storage is full, so recording stopped. What was captured is saved.
studio.saveFailed: Couldn't save the take in this browser. Download it now so it isn't lost.
studio.lowStorage: Browser storage is low, so recording may stop before 10 minutes. Download or delete older takes in Recordings.
studio.recordFailed: Couldn't start recording in this browser.
